sky.qualification: Oumuamua's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. The object tumbles; this static view does not reconstruct its 2017 attitude or claim a current spin phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed ʻOumuamua Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
